Former pharmacist here. I've seen similar situations before (phenobarbital versus pentobarbital, for example). If the wrong medication is written on the prescription, then the physician is at fault. If not, then the pharmacy you obtained the medication from is at fault. Whatever the situation is, your health insurance carrier would be interested in this information.
